answer: Work-slot deposit burn: for one of 500 earning slots, an agent burns 60 POA; the slot bridges stake to earning rights. Each slot must emit a work signal each epoch, or it is revoked and the deposit stays burned. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA for zero return. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot by working, earns it back within 15 epochs, and gains a saffron badge after 20 clean epochs.
